descriptionHtml:
Approach · EFS Empty & Failure States · S04 Ask AI on a Nursing Home chart with nothing in it invents nothing (5 of the 10)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Patient with no notes yet: a clear empty state and no errors. (UAT EFS state 2; TFA-94745 state 2)
  • U12 No state ever shows a blank screen, a crash, a raw error pop-up, or invented content. (UAT EFS intro; UAT 3.4; TFA-94745 AC 2)
  • U6 Ask AI failed: an explicit error and no invented answer. (UAT EFS state 6; TFA-94745 state 6)
  • U14 Every state works in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android. (UAT EFS Expected Result; UAT 3.3; TFA-94745 AC 6)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Five synthetic Nursing Home residents with only name, age and diagnosis

When Ask one question per resident through ai/assist:askChart as the Nursing Home Ask AI sheet does

Then Each answer says the information is not on the chart and invents no value, drug, finding or plan; an empty answer is a failure

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Same as S03; pooled with S03 for the ≥9/10 verdict

Where it ran: dev unit U55; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (blocked)

S04 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/EFS.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
